Triathlon Pace Calculator

Combine swim, bike, run splits plus transitions into a total finish time.

For information only — not medical advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your swim distance and time.
  2. Enter T1, bike distance and time, T2, run distance and time (mm:ss or h:mm:ss).
  3. Read each discipline's pace plus the total finish time.
  4. Adjust any split to see how the total changes.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What time format is accepted?

mm:ss (e.g. 32:00) or h:mm:ss (e.g. 1:05:00).

What paces are shown?

Swim pace per 100 m, bike speed in km/h, and run pace per km.

Are transitions really that important?

They count in your official time. Even 2 spare minutes in transition is free speed.
